issue.body:
VSP02 has exact matched terminal greedy headroom zero on its accepted finite current host. The historical Adam CARRY/RESET exact-success sets match, while their continuous paths differ. That host has a no-op partner and no membership-change semantics.

The prepared direction question is whether to explicitly change scope to a fixed-population, partially observed cooperative task: after an active teammate changes policy, does resetting complete Adam state improve fixed-budget native team return relative to carrying it from the same learned policy?

The Convergence node is asked to accept or decline that scope change, or request a distinct real-membership population proposal. If accepted, it should identify one population/policy pair and the smallest bounded B question. No benchmark, teammate pair, successor, recast or runtime budget has been selected locally.

- [P11 question and boundaries](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/32bbf1d8b4608ed0a2e311ef381a8a742b22e409/docs/research/candidates/vsp_02/VSP02_P11_NEXT_QUESTION_PREPARATION_INTAKE_20260907.md).
